record: The sanitized production schema the local-CI job restores on the GitHub runner. Built from the production dump at ledger 0304: the whole schema, reference rows only (permissions, roles, role_permissions, app_settings, shops, branches, storage.buckets), plus the RBAC supplement for the surface production never received (business_areas). No personal data, no password hashes, no business rows — the build refuses to write an artifact that carries a fixture identity. CI-only; never a migrate target.
dataNote: Only the reference rows the suite needs are restored (see the build report); every other row block in the source dump is left out. The build asserts the kept row counts exactly, so a source dump with different reference data fails loudly.

ledgerOnServer.note: Production ledger at capture. Forward files 0233-0302 plus 0305 apply on top of this artifact in local-db init; that order is recorded in forwardOrder.

policy.note: Local CI test target only. It is checked against, never written by hosted tooling; the local stack is discarded after the run.

forwardNote: Apply order for local-db init: the test-auth helper first (0071 _test_check_auth), then the agent/impact tables (0075-0078), then 0305 (the enum labels batch 1 needs), then the production batches in version order (0233-0276, 0277-0289, 0291-0299, 0300-0302). 0070 is deliberately NOT in this order: its run_sql body is invalid PL/pgSQL (RETURN (EXECUTE ...) — EXECUTE is a statement, not an expression) and has never applied anywhere, yet it is recorded in the QA ledger with its current hash, so editing it would break migrate verify; the suite's run_sql comes from tests/setup/create_run_sql.sql instead, applied by the local-CI job via `local-db apply` (the same file QA got by hand).
refresh: Re-run this script against a fresh production dump when production receives migrations beyond 0305, and commit the regenerated artifact + record together.
recheck: npm run local:db -- init --baseline local-ci --skip-verify && npm run local:db -- seed && npm run local:db -- verify --baseline local-ci
